"""Frankenduck body shell side, native STEVE part (port of cad_blender/code_cad/body_shell/build.py,
canonical variant `--collar --locators`). World millimetres at the saved assembly pose.

Parameter SIDE: +1 builds left_shell (Y >= 0), -1 builds right_shell (Y <= 0, KCD1 port and collar).
The skin is the analytic fair surface (periodic cubic B-spline profile, straight band, rational
quarter-ellipse return, flat side panel), trimmed and thickened 3 mm inward; the rest are solid
features measured on the canonical mesh.
"""
import math
import cadquery as cq
from OCP.BRepBuilderAPI import BRepBuilderAPI_MakeFace, BRepBuilderAPI_Sewing, BRepBuilderAPI_Transform
from OCP.BRepOffsetAPI import BRepOffsetAPI_MakeThickSolid
from OCP.BRepPrimAPI import BRepPrimAPI_MakeBox
from OCP.Geom import Geom_BSplineSurface
from OCP.ShapeCustom import ShapeCustom
from OCP.TColStd import TColStd_Array1OfReal, TColStd_Array1OfInteger, TColStd_Array2OfReal
from OCP.TColgp import TColgp_Array2OfPnt
from OCP.gp import gp_Ax2, gp_Dir, gp_Pnt, gp_Trsf
from steve import Model

SIDE = 1                    # mm-free flag: 1 = left shell (+Y), -1 = right shell (-Y)
SWITCH_PORT = 0             # 1 = KCD1 rocker port and guard collar (right shell only)
NECK_NOTCH_HALF_WIDTH = 17.6  # mm |Y| of the neck notch walls (left 17.6, right 20.6)

# Outer skin
SKIN_CENTRE_X = -17.0       # mm X of the side-return scaling centre
SKIN_CENTRE_Z = 148.5       # mm Z of the side-return scaling centre
Y_RETURN = 30.5             # mm |Y| where the straight extrusion ends
RETURN_DEPTH = 12.5         # mm |Y| span of the elliptical return (panel at 43)
PANEL_SCALE = 0.72          # profile scale at the flat side panel
WALL = 3.0                  # mm wall, inward normal offset of the skin
PROFILE_CTL_XZ = [          # mm periodic cubic B-spline control points of the profile (X, Z)
    (-61.969364, 141.721413), (-60.769652, 133.872594), (-57.276993, 126.803988),
    (-50.794014, 122.358513), (-43.022885, 120.769484), (-35.077182, 120.67624),
    (-27.125195, 120.697049), (-19.174847, 120.866402), (-11.224499, 121.035755),
    (-3.274151, 121.205108), (4.676196, 121.374461), (12.626544, 121.543815),
    (20.576892, 121.713168), (26.636799, 126.072967), (28.103164, 133.853673),
    (28.415338, 141.798651), (28.519343, 149.748904), (26.829561, 157.478466),
    (22.453743, 164.065265), (16.146531, 168.833552), (8.767016, 171.7796),
    (1.031361, 173.596575), (-6.854049, 174.594652), (-14.797595, 174.91515),
    (-22.749282, 174.893843), (-30.701087, 174.819608), (-38.641541, 174.419028),
    (-46.516012, 173.371864), (-53.96208, 170.678255), (-59.525821, 165.128391),
    (-61.936164, 157.59931), (-62.307761, 149.666182),
]
# Surface trims (before thickening)
HIP_Y_HALF = 38.2           # mm |Y| of the hip/leg opening
HIP_Z_TOP = 127.5           # mm top of the hip/leg opening
FRONT_X_MIN = 6.0           # mm front-top opening start X
FRONT_Y_HALF = 36.0         # mm front-top opening |Y|
FRONT_Z_MIN = 154.5         # mm front-top opening bottom Z
# Seam
SEAM_GAP = 0.075            # mm halves stop short of Y = 0
PATCH_X_MAX = -48.0         # mm rear battery-cover patch window X max (meets Y = 0)
PATCH_Z_MIN = 147.6         # mm patch window Z min
PATCH_Z_MAX = 169.0         # mm patch window Z max
# Solid cuts
CORRIDOR_X_MIN = -56.0      # mm carrier corridor X min
CORRIDOR_X_MAX = -37.25     # mm carrier corridor X max
CORRIDOR_Y_HALF = 22.5      # mm carrier corridor |Y|
CORRIDOR_Z_TOP = 160.75     # mm carrier corridor top
SERVICE_X_MIN = -28.5       # mm top service opening X min
SERVICE_Y_HALF = 24.5       # mm top service opening |Y|
SERVICE_Z_MIN = 164.0       # mm top service opening bottom
SERVICE_CORNER = 3.0        # mm top service opening rear corner radius
DOOR_X_MAX = -55.5          # mm rear battery doorway X max
DOOR_Y_HALF = 22.5          # mm rear battery doorway |Y|
DOOR_Z_TOP = 147.6          # mm rear battery doorway top
CHAMFER_NX = -0.70248       # rear patch chamfer plane normal X
CHAMFER_NZ = -0.71170       # rear patch chamfer plane normal Z
CHAMFER_D = -61.7262        # mm rear patch chamfer plane offset
NOTCH_NX = 0.51308          # neck notch plane normal X
NOTCH_NZ = 0.85834          # neck notch plane normal Z
NOTCH_D = 142.1346          # mm neck notch plane offset
NOTCH_X_MIN = 20.0          # mm neck notch X min
# Screw lands
DECK_Y = 37.0               # mm |Y| deck contact plane
SPOT_R = 4.85               # mm deck spot face radius
BOSS_Z = 162.0              # mm screw boss axis Z
BOSS_REAR_X = -24.0         # mm rear boss X
BOSS_R = 4.6                # mm boss radius
BOSS_ROUND = 0.45           # mm boss top round
PAD_X = -20.0               # mm rear screw pad X
PAD_R = 3.5                 # mm rear screw pad radius
FRONT_X = 10.0              # mm front screw X
WELL_R = 2.6                # mm PA2x8 head well radius
REAR_WELL_FLOOR = 41.15     # mm |Y| rear head well floor
FRONT_WELL_FLOOR = 40.35    # mm |Y| front head well floor
BORE_R = 1.1                # mm screw bore radius
BORE_END = 36.9             # mm |Y| bore end
# Locators
BASE_TOP_Z = 164.45         # mm trunk base top face
SOCKET_FLAT_X = 5.6         # mm front ring flat X
SOCKET_R = 3.2              # mm front socket radius
RING_START = 40.5           # mm |Y| ring start (inside the wall)
RING_END = 35.0             # mm |Y| ring leading edge
ENTRY_CHAMFER = 0.6         # mm socket entry chamfer
LIP_X_MIN = -21.6           # mm rear lip X min
LIP_X_MAX = -16.0           # mm rear lip X max
LIP_START = 40.5            # mm |Y| rear lip start
LIP_END = 35.6              # mm |Y| rear lip leading edge
LIP_T = 1.5                 # mm rear lip thickness
LIP_LEAD = 0.6              # mm rear lip lead-in chamfer
# KCD1 rocker port and collar (right shell)
SW_X = -36.0                # mm switch axis X
SW_Z = 139.0                # mm switch axis Z
SW_HOLE_R = 7.5             # mm snap-in hole radius
SW_KEY_HALF = 1.0           # mm key half width
SW_KEY_TOP = 146.7          # mm key top Z
SW_RELIEF_Y = 41.0          # mm |Y| relief floor
SW_RELIEF_R = 10.0          # mm relief radius at the floor
SW_RELIEF_DEPTH = 3.0       # mm 45-degree relief depth
COLLAR_RI = 10.0            # mm collar inner radius
COLLAR_RO = 12.5            # mm collar outer radius
COLLAR_RIM_Y = 50.6         # mm |Y| collar rim
COLLAR_CH = 0.6             # mm collar rim chamfers
COLLAR_RF = 13.5            # mm collar foot radius
COLLAR_BASE_Y = 41.5        # mm |Y| collar base

S = 1.0 if SIDE > 0 else -1.0
Y_PANEL = Y_RETURN + RETURN_DEPTH


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
def _y(a):
    """World Y of a shell-side |Y| value."""
    return S * a


def _box(x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1):
    y0, y1 = sorted((y0, y1))
    return cq.Solid.makeBox(x1 - x0, y1 - y0, z1 - z0, cq.Vector(x0, y0, z0))


def _cyl_y(x, z, r, a0, a1):
    """Cylinder about an axis parallel to Y between shell-side |Y| a0 and a1."""
    y0, y1 = sorted((_y(a0), _y(a1)))
    return cq.Solid.makeCylinder(r, y1 - y0, cq.Vector(x, y0, z), cq.Vector(0, 1, 0))


def _cone_in(x, z, r0, r1, a, h):
    """Cone starting at |Y| = a and growing toward the inside (smaller |Y|)."""
    return cq.Solid.makeCone(r0, r1, h, cq.Vector(x, _y(a), z), cq.Vector(0, -S, 0))


def _halfspace(n, d, lo, hi):
    """{p: n.p >= d} within the axis box lo..hi (lo/hi already world)."""
    l = math.sqrt(sum(c * c for c in n))
    n = [c / l for c in n]
    ax = gp_Ax2(gp_Pnt(*(c * d for c in n)), gp_Dir(*n))
    xd, yd = ax.XDirection(), ax.YDirection()
    big = 400.0
    o = [n[i] * d - (xd.Coord(i + 1) + yd.Coord(i + 1)) * big / 2 for i in range(3)]
    slab = cq.Shape.cast(BRepPrimAPI_MakeBox(gp_Ax2(gp_Pnt(*o), gp_Dir(*n), xd), big, big, big).Shape())
    return _box(lo[0], hi[0], lo[1], hi[1], lo[2], hi[2]).intersect(slab)


def _row(q, y):
    return [(SKIN_CENTRE_X + q * (x - SKIN_CENTRE_X), y, SKIN_CENTRE_Z + q * (z - SKIN_CENTRE_Z))
            for x, z in PROFILE_CTL_XZ]


def _bspline(rows, weights, vdeg, vmults):
    n = len(rows[0])
    poles = TColgp_Array2OfPnt(1, n, 1, len(rows))
    w = TColStd_Array2OfReal(1, n, 1, len(rows))
    for j, row in enumerate(rows):
        for i in range(n):
            poles.SetValue(i + 1, j + 1, gp_Pnt(*row[i]))
            w.SetValue(i + 1, j + 1, weights[j])
    uk = TColStd_Array1OfReal(1, n + 1)
    um = TColStd_Array1OfInteger(1, n + 1)
    for i in range(n + 1):
        uk.SetValue(i + 1, float(i))
        um.SetValue(i + 1, 1)
    vk = TColStd_Array1OfReal(1, 2)
    vk.SetValue(1, 0.0)
    vk.SetValue(2, 1.0)
    vm = TColStd_Array1OfInteger(1, 2)
    vm.SetValue(1, vmults)
    vm.SetValue(2, vmults)
    surf = Geom_BSplineSurface(poles, w, uk, vk, um, vm, 3, vdeg, True, False)
    return cq.Face(BRepBuilderAPI_MakeFace(surf, 1e-7).Face())


def _mirror_y(shape):
    t = gp_Trsf()
    t.SetMirror(gp_Ax2(gp_Pnt(0, 0, 0), gp_Dir(0, 1, 0)))
    return cq.Shape.cast(BRepBuilderAPI_Transform(shape.wrapped, t, True).Shape())


def thickened_wall():
    """Skin in the right-shell frame (Y <= 0), trimmed, thickened inward, mirrored for the left."""
    y1, y2 = -Y_RETURN, -Y_PANEL
    band = _bspline([_row(1.0, 0.0), _row(1.0, y1)], [1.0, 1.0], 1, 2)
    ret = _bspline([_row(1.0, y1), _row(1.0, y2), _row(PANEL_SCALE, y2)],
                   [1.0, math.sqrt(0.5), 1.0], 2, 3)
    rim = [e for e in ret.Edges() if e.IsClosed() and abs(e.Center().y - y2) < 1e-6]
    panel = cq.Face.makeFromWires(cq.Wire.assembleEdges(rim))
    sew = BRepBuilderAPI_Sewing(1e-6)
    for f in (band, ret, panel):
        sew.Add(f.wrapped)
    sew.Perform()
    skin = cq.Shape.cast(sew.SewedShape())
    hip = _box(-120, 120, -HIP_Y_HALF, HIP_Y_HALF, 60, HIP_Z_TOP)
    front = _box(FRONT_X_MIN, 120, -FRONT_Y_HALF, FRONT_Y_HALF, FRONT_Z_MIN, 260)
    trimmed = skin.cut(hip, front)
    mk = BRepOffsetAPI_MakeThickSolid()
    mk.MakeThickSolidBySimple(trimmed.wrapped, -WALL)
    mk.Build()
    wall = cq.Shape.cast(mk.Shape()).Solids()[0]
    wall = cq.Shape.cast(ShapeCustom.ConvertToBSpline_s(wall.wrapped, False, False, True, False))
    return _mirror_y(wall) if S > 0 else wall


def seam_cut():
    slab = _box(-120, 120, _y(SEAM_GAP), _y(-1.0), 60, 260)
    keep = _box(-120, PATCH_X_MAX, _y(SEAM_GAP + 1), _y(-2.0), PATCH_Z_MIN, PATCH_Z_MAX)
    return slab.cut(keep)


def top_service_cut():
    b = _box(SERVICE_X_MIN, 120, -SERVICE_Y_HALF, SERVICE_Y_HALF, SERVICE_Z_MIN, 260)
    edges = [e for e in b.Edges() if abs(e.Center().x - SERVICE_X_MIN) < 1e-6
             and abs(e.endPoint().z - e.startPoint().z) > 1.0]
    return b.fillet(SERVICE_CORNER, edges)


def boss(x, r, rnd):
    b = _cyl_y(x, BOSS_Z, r, Y_PANEL - WALL + 0.5, DECK_Y)
    if rnd > 0:
        edges = [e for e in b.Edges() if e.IsClosed() and abs(e.Center().y - _y(DECK_Y)) < 1e-6]
        b = b.fillet(rnd, edges)
    return b


def locator_ring():
    ring = _cyl_y(FRONT_X, BOSS_Z, SPOT_R, RING_START, RING_END)
    return ring.cut(_box(FRONT_X - 10, SOCKET_FLAT_X, _y(DECK_Y), 0.0, BOSS_Z - 10, BOSS_Z + 10))


def locator_socket():
    past = 0.2
    y_ch = RING_END + ENTRY_CHAMFER
    sock = _cyl_y(FRONT_X, BOSS_Z, SOCKET_R, DECK_Y, RING_END - past).intersect(
        _box(FRONT_X - 10, FRONT_X + 10, _y(60), 0.0, BOSS_Z - 10, BASE_TOP_Z))
    cone = _cone_in(FRONT_X, BOSS_Z, SOCKET_R, SOCKET_R + ENTRY_CHAMFER + past, y_ch, ENTRY_CHAMFER + past)
    # in the right frame n = (0, 1, -1); mirrored for the left
    roof = _halfspace((0.0, -S, -1.0), -(BASE_TOP_Z + y_ch) / math.sqrt(2.0),
                      (FRONT_X - 10, min(_y(y_ch), _y(RING_END - past)), BOSS_Z - 10),
                      (FRONT_X + 10, max(_y(y_ch), _y(RING_END - past)), BASE_TOP_Z + 5))
    return sock.fuse(cone.intersect(roof))


def rear_lip():
    yz = [(LIP_START, BASE_TOP_Z), (LIP_END + LIP_LEAD, BASE_TOP_Z), (LIP_END, BASE_TOP_Z + LIP_LEAD),
          (LIP_END, BASE_TOP_Z + LIP_T), (LIP_START, BASE_TOP_Z + LIP_T)]
    w = cq.Wire.makePolygon([cq.Vector(LIP_X_MIN, _y(a), z) for a, z in yz], close=True)
    return cq.Solid.extrudeLinear(cq.Face.makeFromWires(w), cq.Vector(LIP_X_MAX - LIP_X_MIN, 0, 0))


def collar():
    pts = [(COLLAR_RI, COLLAR_BASE_Y), (COLLAR_RF, COLLAR_BASE_Y), (COLLAR_RF, Y_PANEL),
           (COLLAR_RO, Y_PANEL + (COLLAR_RF - COLLAR_RO)), (COLLAR_RO, COLLAR_RIM_Y - COLLAR_CH),
           (COLLAR_RO - COLLAR_CH, COLLAR_RIM_Y), (COLLAR_RI + COLLAR_CH, COLLAR_RIM_Y),
           (COLLAR_RI, COLLAR_RIM_Y - COLLAR_CH)]
    w = cq.Wire.makePolygon([cq.Vector(SW_X + r, _y(a), SW_Z) for r, a in pts], close=True)
    return cq.Solid.revolve(cq.Face.makeFromWires(w), 360, cq.Vector(SW_X, 0, SW_Z), cq.Vector(SW_X, 1, SW_Z))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- features
model = Model()
model.add("wall", thickened_wall(), name="Fair skin, trimmed, thickened 3 mm inward")
model.add("seam", seam_cut(), op="cut", name="Seam gap with rear patch window")
model.add("top_service", top_service_cut(), op="cut", name="Top service opening")
model.add("rear_doorway", _box(-120, DOOR_X_MAX, -DOOR_Y_HALF, DOOR_Y_HALF, 60, DOOR_Z_TOP), op="cut",
          name="Rear battery doorway")
model.add("rear_chamfer", _halfspace((CHAMFER_NX, 0.0, CHAMFER_NZ), CHAMFER_D, (-80, -DOOR_Y_HALF, 140),
                                     (-55, DOOR_Y_HALF, 152)), op="cut", name="Rear patch chamfer")
model.add("corridor", _box(CORRIDOR_X_MIN, CORRIDOR_X_MAX, -CORRIDOR_Y_HALF, CORRIDOR_Y_HALF, 60, CORRIDOR_Z_TOP),
          op="cut", name="Carrier corridor")
model.add("neck_notch", _halfspace((NOTCH_NX, 0.0, NOTCH_NZ), NOTCH_D,
                                   (NOTCH_X_MIN, -NECK_NOTCH_HALF_WIDTH, 120), (60, NECK_NOTCH_HALF_WIDTH, 200)),
          op="cut", name="Neck notch")
model.add("boss_rear", boss(BOSS_REAR_X, BOSS_R, BOSS_ROUND), op="join", name="Rear screw boss")
model.add("pad_rear", boss(PAD_X, PAD_R, 0.0), op="join", name="Rear screw pad")
model.add("boss_front", boss(FRONT_X, BOSS_R, BOSS_ROUND), op="join", name="Front screw boss")
model.add("spot_rear", _cyl_y(PAD_X, BOSS_Z, SPOT_R, DECK_Y, -1.0), op="cut", name="Rear deck spot face")
model.add("spot_front", _cyl_y(FRONT_X, BOSS_Z, SPOT_R, DECK_Y, -1.0), op="cut", name="Front deck spot face")
model.add("locator_ring", locator_ring(), op="join", name="Front locator ring")
model.add("locator_lip", rear_lip(), op="join", name="Rear locator lip")
model.add("locator_socket", locator_socket(), op="cut", name="Front locator socket")
model.add("well_rear", _cyl_y(PAD_X, BOSS_Z, WELL_R, 60.0, REAR_WELL_FLOOR), op="cut", name="Rear head well")
model.add("bore_rear", _cyl_y(PAD_X, BOSS_Z, BORE_R, 60.0, BORE_END), op="cut", name="Rear screw bore")
model.add("well_front", _cyl_y(FRONT_X, BOSS_Z, WELL_R, 60.0, FRONT_WELL_FLOOR), op="cut", name="Front head well")
model.add("bore_front", _cyl_y(FRONT_X, BOSS_Z, BORE_R, 60.0, BORE_END), op="cut", name="Front screw bore")
if SWITCH_PORT:
    model.add("collar", collar(), op="join", name="Switch guard collar")
    model.add("switch_hole", _cyl_y(SW_X, SW_Z, SW_HOLE_R, 60.0, SW_RELIEF_Y - 0.5), op="cut",
              name="KCD1 snap-in hole")
    model.add("switch_key", _box(SW_X - SW_KEY_HALF, SW_X + SW_KEY_HALF, _y(60.0), _y(SW_RELIEF_Y - 0.5),
                                 SW_Z, SW_KEY_TOP), op="cut", name="KCD1 key")
    model.add("switch_relief", _cone_in(SW_X, SW_Z, SW_RELIEF_R, SW_RELIEF_R + SW_RELIEF_DEPTH, SW_RELIEF_Y,
                                        SW_RELIEF_DEPTH), op="cut", name="KCD1 45-degree relief")
# Rigid print: provisional PLA library properties; existing local profile uses Bambu PLA Matte.
model.material("pla", color="#99deef")
result = model.result()
name: left_shell_native
